Bengal CM Vows Stricter Cow Slaughter Law, Aid for Goshalas

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has announced plans for a stricter law on cow slaughter and pledged ₹1 lakh in aid for the state's goshalas (cow shelters). The announcement follows a commitment to end illegal slaughter of 'gau mata' (cows).
